! Phase-4 cEOS startup-config — ceos1
! eAPI on the management interface, plus L3/BGP/SNMP configuration.
!
! NOTE: Management0 is intentionally NOT configured here — containerlab assigns the mgmt IP
! (172.30.30.11, from topology.clab.yml `mgmt-ipv4`) to Management0 automatically for arista_ceos.
! Adding an explicit `interface Management0 ip address ...` here can conflict with that injection.
!
hostname ceos1
!
! Lab credentials — STATIC. This is the honest WS4 non-conformance: the device is reached with a
! static service credential, NOT the JWKS-forwarded per-user identity WS4 R2a mandates.
! admin login: provisioned out of band by the rig bootstrap (never committed to this repo)
!
! eAPI: enable on the default VRF (Management0 lives there) over HTTP (pyeapi/NAPALM-eos talk to it).
! HTTPS is also enabled so the inventory can use either transport; the nornir inventory pins http.
management api http-commands
   no shutdown
   protocol http
   protocol https
   !
   vrf default
      no shutdown
!
ip routing
!
! Data interface toward ceos2 (eth1 == Ethernet1).
interface Ethernet1
   description to-ceos2
   no switchport
   ip address 10.0.12.1/30
!
! FW-A3.2 security-policy ports (2026-08-21) — bindable interfaces for the firewall use-case legs.
! Roles are carried by DESCRIPTIONS; no L3 addressing needed for ACL binding.
interface Ethernet2
   description DMZ-SEGMENT (dmz zone) — toward dmz-sg cloud segment
   no switchport
interface Ethernet3
   description PARTNER-UPLINK (untrust zone) — partner-internet ingress
   no switchport
!
!
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
! Telemetry-exporter pool (10.99.0.0/24) — existing allocations.
! Do not renumber or consolidate: the addresses are generated by randomize-t6-seed.py
! (`python3 randomize-t6-seed.py --write` on rig rebuild) and change per rebuild.
! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
interface Loopback11
   description telemetry-exporter (existing allocation)
   ip address 10.99.0.1/32
!
interface Loopback12
   description telemetry-exporter (existing allocation)
   ip address 10.99.0.26/32
!
interface Loopback13
   description telemetry-exporter (existing allocation)
   ip address 10.99.0.29/32
!
! eBGP toward ceos2.
router bgp 65001
   router-id 1.1.1.1
   neighbor 10.0.12.2 remote-as 65002
   neighbor 10.0.12.2 description to-ceos2
   !
   ! Existing exporter /32s are advertised.
   network 10.99.0.1/32
   network 10.99.0.26/32
   network 10.99.0.29/32
   !
   address-family ipv4
      neighbor 10.0.12.2 activate
!
! SNMP read-only community.
snmp-server community <<REDACTED-SECRET>> ro
!
end
